messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: Paging: gpu-host gnode-17 reporting repeated CUDA Xid 124/127 driver resets, ECC spikes. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Affected services: inference-runtime, batch-encoder.

Kira: Oncall — I see the alerts in Datadog and node metrics. Node has 12 resets in last 10m. Starting triage.

Samir: Logged into ops jumpbox, pulling dmesg now. outputs show repeated GPU panic entries.

Marta: Clients reporting increased 504s for hosted-api-rw; 2 tenants showing elevated error rates. Not yet a full outage but high error ratio on gen endpoints.

Kira: Thanks. Plan: 1) cordon gnode-17 2) drain non-critical pods 3) move critical inference traffic to backup pool 4) collect nvml/dmesg logs and GPU ECC stats. Doing cordon now.

Samir: Command I ran: ```kubectl cordon gnode-17 && kubectl drain gnode-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60```

Evan: Started graceful drain; one legacy dedicated pod blocked on local storage. I'm going to evict via force after a quick check.

Marta: Notifying affected customers via status page. Posting a note: "We are investigating GPU driver resets on a single host; some inference requests may see increased latency or errors."

Kira: Collected kernel logs snippet:
```
[ 3456.789012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 124: Hostengine exception
[ 3456.789045] NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00: GPU panic - skipping taint cleanup
```

Samir: NVML query shows ECC corrected errors ramping up and then driver reset. Running `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,DRIVER` and saving output to /tmp/gnode17-ecc.log

Kira: While draining, I want a quick mitigation: set runtime to fallback-model-routing so we can offload heavy gen traffic to cpu-backup pool for ~15m. Marta, can you flip the routing rule?

Marta: On it. Pushed canary rule to route 20% of requests to backup_pool, and emergency fallback to cpu-fallback for endpoints with >3 errors/5m.

DeployBot: Deploy started: traffic-rule/route-fallback v2 -> canary(20%) (sha: a3f5d).

Kira: Good. GridOps, do we have a remediation playbook for persistent Xid flares? If node keeps flapping we might need to isolate the entire rack and schedule a maintenance window.

GridOps: We do. Steps: 1) isolate host at hypervisor 2) repro with stress test if hardware available 3) RMA if ECC uncorrectable or repeated driver resets after latest driver rollback. Also check kernel+driver regressions; which driver version?

Samir: Driver is 535.86.05. There's a known issue on a small subset of AMD/PCI stacks, but not identical. Attempting a driver restart on node to see if that stabilizes.

Kira: Try restarting the nvidia driver module: `systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced` then `modprobe -r nvidia && modprobe nvidia` — scheduled between pod evacuations.

Samir: Did `systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced` — node still shows Xid events immediately after. I'm going to cordon the rest of the hosts that are showing early signs (gnode-19) and move high priority traffic away.

Marta: Customer impact: two enterprise tenants saw ~12% error rate on gen-moderate model for ~7m. Status page updated with "Partial degradation; mitigation in progress" and we linked workaround (retry/backoff).

Evan: I'm collecting the driver crash dumps and GPU core dumps to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incident-1735502468/gnode-17/{dmesg,nvml,core}.tar.gz

Kira: If driver restart doesn't hold after full evacuate, we'll mark node as quarantine and schedule an RMA. For now keep traffic diversion in place and monitor 10m windows.

Samir: After further testing, host still emits Xid 127 when we run a synthetic kernel stress: `./cuda_stress --duration 120`. Repro is reliable.

GridOps: Given reproducible Xid under stress and ECC growth, open hardware ticket and schedule replacement. Quarantine node and drain permanently.

Marta: Filing customer follow-up notes; will prepare incident update for 1h. Any additional asks?

Kira: One more: collect node power/cooling telemetry. Thermal throttle could cause ECC spikes. Samir, Evan can you pull the chassis logs?

Evan: Pulling ipmi sensor data now, exporting to the incident folder.

PagerBot: Incident auto-note: incident-1735502468 created; priority P2; initial responders Kira, Samir, Marta.

Kira: Wrapping up for now — node quarantined, traffic diverted, customer comms live, hardware RMA opened. Leaving follow-on ticket for postmortem and root cause. If anything changes ping @Kira. :white_check_mark:

Marta: Thanks team. I'll prep post-incident checklist and add the observed Xid logs to the postmortem board. :card_file_box:
